canonical.title: IT conferences and tech events within 30 km of Nuance (Duffel)

parent.title: Weekend at Nuance: a 2-Michelin dinner with no hotel next door

siblings.title: Day-trips and activities within 30 km of Nuance
siblings.summary: Mechelen 5 min by train, Antwerp 15 min, Lier 9 min by bus — plus the Sunday-museum / Monday-shop rhythm, breweries, forts and cycle routes.

siblings.title: Walking-distance lodging at or near Nuance
siblings.summary: There is no true walking-distance hotel near Nuance; the restaurant's own picks are Mechelen hotels reached via Taxi Symforosa.

siblings.title: Special-character lodging within taxi range of Nuance
siblings.summary: Heritage and design hotels — convents, orphanages, city palaces — all within a 10-25 minute taxi of Nuance.

sources.title: MICHELIN Guide — Nuance, Duffel (2 stars)
